baselineMethod: Observe the old/manual method on the same frozen task inputs used for the workbench attempt; record actual hands-on time rather than reconstructing it from case age or estimates.
timing: Completed tasks with known observed durationSeconds only; blank is unknown, zero is valid. Report sample count and missing/excluded counts. Never call the sum full-workflow time.
waits: Optional directly observed stageWaitSeconds, separately summarised for completed tasks. Linked case-event calendar intervals remain defined only by config/process-measures.json; never derive either from Created or hands-on duration.
help: Yes / attempted tasks with known yes or no; unknown reported separately.
counts: Missing inputs/corrections summed over attempted tasks with known counts; task denominator reported. Repeated inputs may recur across tasks.
comparison: One baseline and one workbench row per pairId/task with matching nonblank source/input/period/version/variant, completed outcomes and known times. Report signed baseline minus workbench seconds per task, sample counts and exclusions. No pooled cross-task saving, causal claim or access/clinical acceptance inferred.
privacy: Use opaque walkthrough/pair/input references. Keep actual observations and outputs in approved private storage. No participant names, patient data or policy narrative required.

taskDefinitions.find-evidence: Locate the specified reference and verify its identity/provenance link; no policy-currency judgement.
taskDefinitions.find-case: Locate the specified CaseUID and check the correct case opens; no assignment or state change.
taskDefinitions.prepare-package: Prepare the same unapproved package shape/required inputs; content review and approval excluded.
taskDefinitions.record-review: Record a supplied authorised/fictional assertion using required fields; do not invent clinical findings.
taskDefinitions.find-previous-version: Locate the specified preserved edition/version evidence; do not restore or overwrite an original.
